user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with a title so that I can track my work.

positive.title: Create a task with a valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a valid title in the title field
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully and displayed in the task list

positive.title: Create a task with a title containing special characters
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a valid title with special characters (e.g., '@#%&')
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully and displayed in the task list

negative.title: Create a task without a title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title is required

negative.title: Create a task with a duplicate title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title that already exists in the task list
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title must be unique

edge.title: Create a task with the maximum allowed title length
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title that is the maximum allowed length
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully and displayed in the task list

edge.title: Create a task with a title only containing whitespace
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title that contains only whitespace characters
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be just whitespace
